Te. ayyo, ayyō, ayyayō, ayyayyō, ayayō interj. denoting sorrow, lamentation, pity, pain, etc. Kui āige, āigo, āigōna, āike, āiko, āikōna interj. indicating annoyance, impatience, or disgust.
